product_metadata.title: Monarch Specialties Marble-Look Top Sofa Console Table, Black/Grey
features: Materials: MDF, Melamine, Marble Paper, Particle Board
Modern black/grey marble-look top and sleek black tapered legs
The open bottom shelf can be used for added storage or to show case decorative pieces
Dimensions: 44 Inch length x 18 Inch width x 29 Inch height
description: With a modern black/grey marble-look top and sleek black tapered legs, this console sofa table appeals to any living space. The open bottom shelf can be used for added storage or to show case decorative pieces. Perfect for the living room, the entry way or anywhere in your home to display your favorites accents in style.
